sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 50% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases star elemental defense by 80 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Healing Ability Power 20. Heals HP. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
Only [Super Galactic? Guard] Europa & Ganymede can be used as Unlocking Potential material
